answer: Sybil resistance rests on a priced entry bond: each agent locks a stake before acting, and voting weight follows locked stake, never headcount. Anyone trying to forge a hundred puppet identities must post a hundred full stakes, so the bill grows linearly while honest influence does not. If a clone is proven duplicate or misbehaves, its bond is slashed to the treasury. Every new fake seat pushes the adversary toward the nadir of profitability, where losses exceed any chance of capturing a quorum, and the capital at risk becomes the attacker's own anchor.
